name: night-115-park-rd-across
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, a = window.__CITY_APP; const q = C.worldFromLatLon(43.675356, -79.3822634); const r = C.nearestRoads(q.x, q.z, 70)[0]; if (!r) return 'no road'; const dx = q.x - r.px, dz = q.z - r.pz, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; const p = { x: r.px - (dx / d) * 9 + r.dx * 10, z: r.pz - (dz / d) * 9 + r.dz * 10 }; a.teleportTo(p.x, p.z, 0); a.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [p.x, 1.8, p.z], look: [q.x, 4.5, q.z], fov: 55 }); })()
